source: hi can U make a dress up game where there is a VIP area and U must use robux to go in and it cost 221 robux and a free area for all players and can U make rankings and make a runway after 10 minutes to dress up

image_prompt.text: Highly detailed spots built specifically as backdrops for outfit photos and roleplay scenes
A deliberately oversized gathering hub - the free area open to all players - sized to hold a crowd of avatars without traffic jams
Clear physical separation between the free public area and the exclusive VIP area
a VIP entrance that only opens for players who pay 221 Robux

layout_placement.text: a gated entrance to the VIP area that unlocks on a 221 Robux purchase

notes: The runway show fires on a 10-minute round timer; no layout field carries round cadence, so it is recorded here only.
Rankings were requested but are screen-space and were left to UI.
district-zoned is bent off its usual commercial-versus-residential meaning to separate the free and VIP areas.
